utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara—could you swing by late and help sort donations or hand out supplies?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure—I can swing by late and help sort donations or hand out supplies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you bring the tool box, some gloves, and a roll of duct tape? If you can, also check whether we still have the extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring the toolbox, gloves, and duct tape, and I’ll check on the extension cord too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and make a quick list of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — that’d really help. I might’ve missed a few things, so a quick list would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a look and jot down what we’ve got, then I’ll flag anything we’re short on for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — the biggest thing is figuring out who’s bringing what and when. I’m a little worried we’ll end up with too many tools and not enough hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help coordinate that. I’ll check with people about tools and see who can come lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I want to know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’m still in — thanks. I’ve only heard bits, so what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you bring your toolbox if you’ve got one, plus a few rags and some gloves? I’ll handle the list and meet you there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a decent turnout—folks are dropping off all sorts of broken bits. I can swing by later and see what still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, that’d be great—there’s plenty to sort through. If you’ve got time, bring any basic tools you’re willing to lend.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet—I’ll grab my toolbox and head over after lunch. If I spot anything that needs a steady hand, I’ll jump right in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about it already — if you want, I can swing by and help spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Quinn—thank you. I’ve got the flyers by the front door if you want to grab some.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll grab a handful and start handing them out right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re actually available to help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’m available and happy to help with the repair drive. What would you like me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m putting together the repair drive now, Bo—want to help me sort the list and assign a few jobs?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help sort it and take a few jobs. Send me the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo—thank you. I’ll send over the list now, and we can split it into easy jobs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’d appreciate that — I’ll be here and ready with a simple list so folks know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll tell the neighbors and keep the repair drive details moving along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may need a quick reminder on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. We still need a few people to sort donations and check the tool boxes, if you don’t mind.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, I can sort donations and take a look at the tool boxes. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help connect people for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great, Jules—thanks. I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Ira — thank you. I’ll keep lining up neighbors and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word right away. If you want, I can also help remind folks about the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I’ll try to swing by late and see who’s there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll make sure people know to come by late too. See you there, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still happy to help with the repair drive—just tell me where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. The clearest plan is to start at my place at 10, then we can check the porch light and the leaky faucet first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be at your place by 10, and we can start with the porch light and faucet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help around the school schedule, but I’d need the repair drive details first so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring you the repair drive details next so you can plan around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — bring me the repair drive details and I’ll work them into the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help connect folks for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll send you the details and you can help spread the word to folks who might want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, send them over and I’ll share it around. Happy to help get more hands on deck.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I've got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s really helpful, Gus. I’m just trying to make sure we have the right tools set aside before people start arriving.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem—what’s on your checklist so far? I can set aside anything I’ve got and help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked anything about the repair drive yet, Rosa. Tell me the location and I’ll keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got you—let’s keep it simple. The repair drive is at the community center on Maple Street, and I’ll send over the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ve got it noted: community center on Maple Street. Send the details when you’re ready, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — how’s the repair drive going, and do you still need any help?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — it’s going steadily, but I want to double-check the remaining list before I ask for more help. If you’re still available, I may need a hand sorting the items.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — send me the list, and I’ll help sort the items.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help me track down any spare tools and donate whatever repair supplies you can spare?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check my shed and garage for any spare tools and supplies I can donate. I’ll bring what I can by later today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think it’s coming up soon, but I might’ve missed the details; I should check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah—just let me know when you find out. I’m mostly trying to figure out when and where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure the repair drive is happening today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s what I heard — it’s happening today. I’m still checking the exact time, but I’ll let you know if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just let me know once you confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m glad you brought that up. I can help, but I might need a little reminder on what we’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re fixing the shared bench and the loose fence panels. I can send you the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes please, send me the list — I’ll take a look and help where I can.
